name: frontend
description: Usage: open Claude Code in the folder where the new project should go and run /frontend:new-project. It asks one question form (framework, name, i18n, extras), or takes the answers as arguments (/frontend:new-project next my-shop mn,en forms,toasts), then renders a checked React + Vite or Next.js template with pnpm, strict TypeScript, Tailwind v4 + shadcn, Biome + oxlint, TanStack Query and Vitest (80% coverage gate). Needs Node 24+ and pnpm.
